title: Our strategy
intro: We work towards a fairer future with an end to poverty, injustice and inequality.

blocks.heading: Our mission
paragraphs: We address poverty and injustice through advice and support, influence systemic change, shift power to people and communities affected by injustice, and collaborate to build fairer systems.

blocks.heading: Change starts close to home
paragraphs: We want a thriving local community where people have the resources they need, their voices are heard and they can feel optimistic about the future. We also aim to be a fair, empowering employer and an effective partner.
